author: Unity
description:
What does the future of graphics look like beyond gaming in Industry? In Episode 5 of the Industry Partner Podcast, we’re joined by Unity’s VP, Graphics Engineering, Charles Sanglimsuwan! 

In this episode, we discuss insights on Unity’s graphics impact across games and Industrial to highlight the opportunities it creates for our Industry growth.  

Interested in becoming a Unity Industry Partner? Head over to: https://on.unity.com/UnityPartners

#Unity #UnityIndustry #UnityPartnerProgram
title: The Unity Industry Partner Podcast - Episode 5: Industry & Games. Two Become One
